principles: Single source of truth: review-assurance guidance must be derived from the canonical DONE/review-assurance predicate.
No evidence side effects: status text may guide but must never satisfy review, delivery, host, fallback, Authority, or production gates.
Human text can be richer, machine output must stay parseable and contract-compatible.
Guidance must name legal writers and safe next command families instead of encouraging owner self-signing.
Keep implementation scoped to M3-M4 surfaces and focused smoke coverage.
drivers: Users currently discover review-assurance blockers too late in DONE closeout.
Reviewer/process evidence has strict provenance and cannot be fabricated by main/owner sessions.
The lifecycle CLI has multiple surfaces that must stay consistent: session_brief, story_advance TEST advisory, review_escalation_status, done_prepare, and JSON outputs.

options.name: central-guidance-helper
pros: Keeps reason codes, material binding, legal writers, fallback eligibility, and cannot-auto-sign text consistent across surfaces
Minimizes risk of weakening gate logic by separating guidance rendering from predicate evaluation
Easy to cover with a single focused smoke fixture
cons: Requires touching several CLI surfaces to thread the helper output

options.name: surface-local-messages
pros: Small changes at each command surface
Fast to implement if each surface already has local blocker text
cons: Likely diverges from canonical gate predicate
Higher chance one surface suggests unsafe self-signing or stale commands

options.name: gate-only-no-new-text
cons: Does not solve the user problem because agents still learn the requirement too late

rationale: A shared guidance helper preserves the canonical gate as source of truth while projecting safe, early, non-evidence-producing instructions across all required surfaces.

preMortem.scenario: Guidance text drifts from DONE gate behavior
preMortem.consequence: Agent sees misleading next commands or misses required quorum
preMortem.mitigation: Derive guidance from existing review assurance status/runbook rows and cover with smoke fixtures.

preMortem.scenario: Owner session appears allowed to self-sign evidence
preMortem.trigger: Next-command text includes review_pass_set, delivery_check_set, fallback, or host verdict commands without legal-writer warnings
preMortem.consequence: Process provenance bug and invalid DONE evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Add cannot-auto-sign guidance and blocked execution-boundary patterns; smoke asserts wording for reviewer, host, fallback, and delivery cases.

preMortem.trigger: Human guidance is written to JSON stdout
preMortem.mitigation: Keep human guidance in text/stderr or structured JSON fields only where already designed; smoke parses touched JSON outputs.
